_comment: Driver attitudes (Nov 2, 2026 research: team-radio defiance and pushback across each driver's career). ignores: the % of the wall's live calls (BOX, headset) the driver refuses in the game. pushback: how often they'd argue (kept for later; not used). tier: high (ignores >= 10), medium (3-9), low (<= 2). Game odds scaled from documented incidents, not measured frequencies. Every driver in data/races must be listed (apps/web/src/data/drivers.test.ts).
